resources.string: Send files and text to Android phones nearby over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, with no internet, like Quick Share. Nothing goes through a server.
JustShare uses Bluetooth and Wi-Fi to find phones around you and send files directly to them.
What do you want to send?
…or a text, a link, a password
Choose files or write a text, then tap a device. Other phones need JustShare open.
Looking for phones with JustShare open…
It must be the same on both phones.
Open share.justapps.it on both devices: it works on any phone and PC, over Wi-Fi, with a code from anywhere, or fully offline with the camera.
Ready: touch the back of the other phone. It must have JustShare open with nothing selected. No code to confirm.
To receive, just keep JustShare open: the other phone sends by touching this one.
NFC is off: turn it on to send by touching phones.
Open JustShare on the other phone (with nothing selected) and touch again.
The other phone didn’t show up over Bluetooth/Wi-Fi. Keep JustShare open on both and try again.
